while-possessed.npc: It's mine. You can't have it, we found it!

steps.npc: Not dragonstones. I like dragonstones, that's why I came here. However, I found a valuable coin instead, it speaks to me... but you can't have it! It's precious to me!

options.text: I don't want it, I have something better.

steps.player: I don't want it, I have something better.

steps.npc: What is it? Is it dragonstones? I like dragonstones!

steps.speaker: Olbertus (possessed)
steps.text: Ask it for five! It looks rich!

steps.npc: Five? Will it give us five?

steps.text: If the player has less than five dragonstones:

steps.player: No. I don't have five dragonstones.

steps.npc: Well then we are not interested!

steps.text: If the player has five dragonstones:

steps.player: Yes. I have five dragonstones, tell you what, I'll trade you them for that coin you found.

steps.npc: Yes! Yes! We'll trade it for the dragonstones.

steps.speaker: Olbertus (possessed)
steps.text: No we will not! It is too precious!

steps.speaker: Olbertus (possessed)
steps.text: It is trying to trick us! Evil, nasty creature it is. Do not listen to it!

steps.player: I am standing right here, you know? You really are crazy. Yes, I'll give you five! Do we have a deal or not?

steps.text: You give Olbertus a dragonstone and receive a very worn coin in return.

steps.npc: Thanks for helping me, I'm not sure what would have happened if I had continued to listen to the voices in my head.
I took that coin from the Stone Relief in the Crypt of the Moon and trapped my friend Eodan in a secret room behind the relief. Could you return the coin to the relief and set him free?

options.text: No, don't give him your dragonstones.

steps.player: On second thoughts, I'll keep it for myself.

options.text: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.

steps.player: Since it's valuable, I think I'll just just kill you for it.

steps.text: This is a dangerous fight, you will lose your items on death.
Olbertus transforms into a Shaeded Beast, and curses the Altar, rendering it unusable.

steps.speaker: Shaeded Beast
steps.text: I require this one alive human!
